final_anonymous_mutator_classification.analytics_caveat: The long track_site_event overload accepts client-claimed login/player/admin metadata. Those fields are forgeable telemetry unless downstream consumers explicitly treat them as untrusted client claims.
final_anonymous_mutator_classification.compute_caveat: The public ladder RPCs mutate run-scoped scratch rows and clean them on success and exception paths. They do not write authoritative gameplay state, but repeated anonymous calls remain a resource-amplification/rate-limit concern.
final_anonymous_mutator_classification.claim_caveat: Anonymous claim-request endpoints are product-intended writes and remain a spam/rate-limit surface.
final_anonymous_mutator_classification.authorization_conclusion: Anonymous execution is not equivalent to unauthenticated authorization: reviewed authoritative mutators retain session/admin/capability-token or credential checks, while the residual public writers are intentional product entrypoints, telemetry, or ephemeral computation.
